description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractJsonParsableRegistry' that implements 'JsonParsableRegistry'. It manages JSON parsing strategies, handles JSON parsing with exception wrapping, and requires subclasses to implement type resolution from JSON objects.

classes.name: AbstractJsonParsableRegistry
classes.description: An abstract class providing JSON parsing strategy management, exception handling, and type resolution for JSON objects.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a JSON string or object into type T, wrapping exceptions appropriately.

methods.name: getTypes
methods.description: Returns the set of JSON types supported by the registry.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Converts a JSON string or object into type T, resolving the type and applying the corresponding parse strategy.

methods.name: resolveType
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to extract the type identifier from a JSON object.
